stated: The Conservative Party will introduce forest risk commodities legislation early in the next Parliament to tackle the UK's impact on illegal deforestation internationally.

source.quote: Deliver our commitment at COP28 to introduce forest risk commodities legislation early in the next Parliament, tackling our impact on illegal deforestation internationally.

bearing_set.reason: Legislation targeting forest-risk commodities directly aims to reduce UK-linked illegal deforestation, bearing materially on global emissions trajectory and biodiversity/nature outcomes.

membership_note: This is a single-target environmental supply-chain policy. Possible compliance-cost spillovers to O2 (food prices via palm oil, soy) or O13 (business costs) are too marginal and indirect to clear the non-negligible bar given the UK's small share of global commodity demand and the legislation's focus on illegal deforestation only. No other fundamental is plausibly moved in a material way.
